others.route: Permit for recruiting foreign labour (Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation), then an entry visa for residence and work (Decree No. 212 of 2009; Labour Relations Law No. 12 of 2010)

note: Added 2026-11-01 from the permit research (papers.permits.LY), which says every foreign worker needs the permit: every foreign worker is recruited on the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation’s permit, the entry visa for residence and work issued on it (Decree No. 212 of 2009).

sources.title: Libya Security Sector Legislation database (DCAF), General People's Committee Decree No. (212) of 1377 FDP (2009 AD), English translation
sources.said: Entry visas for the purpose of residence and work shall be issued on the basis of a permit for recruiting foreign labour issued by the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation in accordance with the prescribed procedures. … Permits for recruiting labour shall be issued for the entity in charge of the project and shall contain the required number of people that are to be recruited, their specialisations and the country of recruitment. In all cases, the lack of a capable Libyan person to fulfil the position or job for which the foreigner is being recruited must be verified.
